purpose: Retell the v3 business process using distinct v2 elements and explicit output-to-input handoffs; no repeating glass-report world
audio_policy: Identical voice and synthesis speed throughout. No speech tempo/pitch retiming, truncation, old narration or background music.

opening.narration: Today, we'll see InsightGen investigate a real business question on Blue Orbit. Then we'll go under the hood: how business expertise, connected components, and continuous improvement make it work at Amex.
opening.visual: Use the v2 portfolio-question hook once, with a soft entrance and two-part agenda. No repeated platform establishing shot.

recording.policy: Retain unchanged narration and approved speed. Preserve all words; report any reference-window overruns for owner alignment. Fit/pad the complete recording; no UI cropping.

cues.narration: Now, let's see how we make this work in the Amex business setting.
cues.meaning: Connect the demonstrated investigation to its shared enterprise foundation.

cues.narration: General-purpose agents bring reasoning and tools. Our differentiator is the enterprise system around them: business-owned knowledge, reusable expert methods, controlled data access, and evidence-driven improvement.
cues.meaning: The integrated enterprise system is the differentiator; do not name competitors or claim general agents cannot integrate context.

cues.narration: Business teams curate definitions, policies, and context in Enterprise Knowledge Foundation. Their analytical expertise becomes reusable primitives and skills through Skill Foundry.
cues.meaning: Show actual curation actions and business ownership, then source-linked knowledge flows into methods.

cues.narration: The C-sixty definition grounds comparison, segmentation, and testing; those primitives compose into a governed skill, with its source links retained.
cues.meaning: A particular definition and source tether ground the same primitives that become the skill.

cues.narration: Teams use InsightGen to apply that knowledge and skill, connect to permitted data, and return findings with evidence.
cues.meaning: The same composed skill enters an agent run; business teams also use the capability they curate.

cues.narration: As the agent runs, the Agent Observability Framework captures its execution trace and quality signals.
cues.meaning: The run emits its own trace and quality evidence; do not introduce an unrelated monitoring diagram.

cues.narration: Harness Intelligence uses the evidence to diagnose, test, and validate a change. The improved skill returns to Skill Foundry and the next agent run.
cues.meaning: The same amber evidence branch drives a candidate skill change; validation precedes release and return to the same capability.

cues.narration: Built once. Specialized many times. Improving continuously.
cues.meaning: Close the integrated loop and show reuse across the platform.

visual_cutlist.action: The central InsightGen workspace sits on the shared Blue Orbit base. Establish the platform once.
Compare general reasoning/tool capability with governed knowledge, expert methods, protected data and source-linked findings.

Business-team review selects a bookmarked definition and policy context, validates the contribution, and publishes linked knowledge. Role and review-state overlays must show actions, not only a component heading.
The selected source-linked definition leaves the EKF graph and becomes the knowledge input grounding comparison, segmentation and test primitives. End on the v2 Skill Foundry composition.
The knowledge-grounded primitives assemble into the same validated reusable folder.
That composed folder enters InsightGen. The user question runs through source lookup, controlled data, method and findings; those exact steps leave the AOF trace. End on the v2 trace layout.
Continue the same trace; quality checks select one amber branch for diagnosis. Preserve the evidence marker into the next shot.

The carried amber evidence enters Harness. A candidate change passes tests and validation. A locally composited updated instance of the same skill returns to its library and agent workflow, instead of an unrelated glow sweep.
Retain the final platform-wide connected view. Knowledge feedback remains subject to business curation; validated skills and workflows are reused.

acceptance.differentiator: A viewer can explain the value of the integrated enterprise system: business ownership, governed knowledge, reusable methods, controlled access, evidence and validated learning.
acceptance.business_process: Business teams visibly curate and publish expertise, then use agents; execution evidence informs improvement and returns to the shared capability.
acceptance.component_connections: The same definition grounds primitives; the same skill enters a run; that run emits the AOF trace; its evidence enters Harness; the validated update returns to the capability.
acceptance.non_repetition: Each source excerpt is used once. Distinct operations use distinct v2 visuals. No recurring glass-report establishing composition between sections.
